name: 即食脆嫩水果小黄瓜款
description: 带露鲜脆、刺瘤明显、断面细嫩多汁的即食小黄瓜详情页套图

styleLock.direction: fresh-picked green produce commerce, poster hero plus pale-mint panel system
styleLock.backgroundSystem: pale mint section fields #EEF5E3 with pure white cards #FFFFFF, plus one vivid yellow-green poster field #A8D63F edged with deep leaf-green foliage #2E5B2C
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light from top-front, gentle moisture highlights, soft contact shadows under every unit, 5500K, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: round light-wood tray #C79A63 and matte pale-mint board #EEF5E3, always with a visible contact shadow
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep leaf-green #2E5B2C, rounded rectangular tag labels filled #A8D63F, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: solid circular badges filled #2E5B2C carrying one simple white thin-line glyph each, plus rounded tag labels filled #A8D63F
styleLock.presentationRules: stable scale and placement; every hero framing pairs whole units with a cut cross-section slice; the product is always grounded by a contact shadow
noDrift: no changes to label or badge shapes
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh-picked green produce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale mint field #EEF5E3, deep leaf-green #2E5B2C and one vivid yellow-green accent #A8D63F; neutral fresh tone; consistent pale mint #EEF5E3 section fields with pure white #FFFFFF cards and a round light-wood tray #C79A63; bright soft top-front studio light with gentle moisture highlights and soft contact shadows, 5500K; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep leaf-green #2E5B2C; consistent rounded tag labels filled #A8D63F and solid circular badges filled #2E5B2C with simple white thin-line glyphs; stable product scale and placement with whole units always paired with a cut cross-section slice; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏承接搜索点击，一眼看清整瓜与断面
shots.camera: 高角度 45° 俯视圆形木托盘，整瓜与切片全景可见
shots.lighting: 明亮均匀高调光，顶部前侧柔光主光加补光，托盘下柔和接触阴影，5500K
shots.background: 鲜黄绿海报底 #A8D63F，仅顶部两角进入少量深叶绿枝叶 #2E5B2C
shots.props: 一只圆形浅色木托盘；同款薄切片的扇形摆位；两角少量新鲜叶片
shots.textZone: 顶部区域一行短标题「{callout_1}」in #2E5B2C，标题下一枚圆角标签「{callout_2}」filled #A8D63F
shots.promptTemplate: Product hero poster of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Composition: two whole units laid diagonally with a loose fan of thin cross-section slices beside them, all arranged on a round light-wood tray #C79A63, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio light with a soft top-front key and fill, a soft contact shadow under the tray, 5500K. Background: vivid yellow-green poster field #A8D63F with deep leaf-green foliage #2E5B2C entering only the top two corners. The tray and product fill 60-70% of the frame anchored in the lower three quarters; the top quarter completes the poster with one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2E5B2C and one rounded tag label 「{callout_2}」 filled #A8D63F beneath it, reading as one balanced hero poster. Commercial fresh-produce e-commerce quality. Negative: no fake brand wordmark, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no dense body copy, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow, no plastic-looking skin, no duplicated foliage.

shots.intent: 白底合规主图，干净轮廓与露珠赢点击
shots.camera: 平视略微 15° 三/四侧，两只整瓜并排直立，全景可见不被裁切
shots.lighting: 明亮均匀高调影棚光，左前主光加补光板，无硬高光，柔和接触阴影
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two whole units standing upright side by side at a slight 15-degree 3/4 turn, eye-level view, full product visible and not clipped, fresh water droplets on the skin. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and a fill card, no harsh speculars, a soft contact shadow grounding the units. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props. The upright pair fills 60-70% of the frame as a clean centered packshot with even white margins framing it. 8K commercial fresh-produce e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no coloured or gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 放大久放蔫软失水的选购痛点，反衬现摘挺脆
shots.camera: 双格对位构图，两格机位、镜头与裁切完全一致，略微 30° 高角度
shots.lighting: 左格平光压暗发灰；右格明亮侧光，水珠高光清晰，柔和接触阴影，5500K
shots.textZone: 每格底部一条短标签「{callout_1}」/「{callout_2}」in #2E5B2C；底部一行短句「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen of {product}, two matched panels with identical framing, lens and crop. Left panel: an ordinary stored green produce item of the same kind, limp and slightly dull under flat light, conveying the stale-crisper problem, no text and no brand. Right panel: {product} taut, glossy and crisp with fresh water droplets under bright light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both panels photographed at a slight high 30-degree angle. Background pale mint field #EEF5E3 on both panels; the left panel keeps a faint grey cast while the right panel stays bright and fresh, 5500K. Each panel fills 50-60% of its half of the frame and carries one short label at its bottom edge, 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right in #2E5B2C; one short caption line 「{callout_3}」 runs across a clean strip at the bottom of the frame, completing the balanced split composition. Negative: no fabricated freshness test data or statistics, no exaggerated decay, no brand names, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no mismatched camera between the two panels.

shots.intent: 用刺瘤与水珠的近距质感证明新鲜挺脆
shots.camera: 100mm 微距极近特写，右侧低位掠射角度，浅景深，前景锐利
shots.lighting: 右侧低位掠射光，突出细密刺瘤与水珠，高光受控，5500K
shots.background: 浅豆绿哑光板 #EEF5E3，柔和虚化
shots.whitespace: minimal，虚化边缘柔和干净，细节本身就是主体
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the bumpy skin surface and the small water droplets on it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot with a 100mm macro lens at a raking low side angle, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing every fine bump and droplet, controlled highlight, 5500K. Background neutral matte pale mint board #EEF5E3, softly out of focus. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, margins minimal and softly blurred because the texture itself is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no over-smoothed plastic-looking skin, no duplicated droplets, no props, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 断面展示薄皮、细嫩果肉与细籽，证明口感
shots.camera: 90° 正上方俯拍微距切面，浅景深，切面锐利
shots.lighting: 顶部均匀柔光加补光，切面湿润高光干净，5500K
shots.whitespace: minimal，切面细节本身就是主体
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of one freshly cut slice of {product}, tight on the cut face so the thin skin, juicy pale flesh and tiny seeds are all visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with a 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, the cut surface sharp. Even soft top light with a gentle fill and a clean highlight on the moist cut face, 5500K. Background matte white board #FFFFFF. The cut face fills 55-60% of the frame, margins minimal because the cross-section detail itself is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no over-saturated fake green flesh, no duplicated slices, no props, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入田间现摘的真实感，强化新鲜来源
shots.camera: 极低机位仰视穿过藤蔓叶隙，纪实抓拍感
shots.lighting: 上午日光透过叶隙，5500K，斑驳柔和高光与自然接触阴影
shots.background: 藤蔓绿叶 #2E5B2C 与透光亮隙 #EEF5E3
shots.props: 藤架上的绿色叶蔓；下方一只编织采果篮，不遮挡产品
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} hanging on a generic vine trellis among broad green leaves, with a woven harvest basket resting below and never covering the product. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward through the foliage, candid documentary feel. Late-morning daylight filtering through the leaves, 5500K, dappled soft highlights and natural contact shadows. Background of vine canopy in deep leaf green #2E5B2C with bright sky gaps #EEF5E3. The hanging fruit and nearby foliage fill 40-50% of the frame, the leafy canopy and open sky composing one balanced upward view with natural breathing margins. Negative: no visible face, no hands, no other people, no duplicated fruit, no impossible shadows, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用四枚圆形图标讲清生长条件，建立品质印象
shots.camera: 90° 正上方平铺信息图构图，产品置于下三分之一，徽章在其上方一行
shots.lighting: 均匀高调平光，无戏剧化阴影，5500K
shots.background: 浅豆绿场 #EEF5E3 + 白色圆角卡 #FFFFFF
shots.props: 四枚实心圆形徽章，各含一个白色细线图标
shots.textZone: 顶部一行短标题「{callout_1}」in #2E5B2C；四枚圆徽下方各一行短标签「{callout_2}」至「{callout_5}」in #2E5B2C
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic screen of {product} in a clean vertical layout. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed flat from a top-down 90-degree angle: the product upright at a slight 3/4 angle in the lower third, and four solid circular badges filled #2E5B2C in one horizontal row above it, each badge carrying one simple white thin-line glyph only. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow, 5500K. Background pale mint field #EEF5E3 with one white rounded card #FFFFFF behind the badge row. One short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2E5B2C sits at the top of the card; each badge carries one short label beneath it, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」, 「{callout_5}」 in #2E5B2C. The product and badge row together fill 50-60% of the frame as one balanced vertical info layout. Negative: no fabricated farming, organic or certification claims, no numbers or statistics, no dense body text, no mismatched icon styles, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 让买家按采摘规格挑选，减少下单犹豫
shots.camera: 略微三/四侧、统一高度与比例的三组并排
shots.lighting: 三组一致的左前柔光主光加补光，柔和接触阴影，无光比漂移，5500K
shots.props: 一条细哑光刻度条作为尺寸锚点；三个实心圆角规格标签
shots.textZone: 每组下方一条圆角规格标签「{callout_1}」/「{callout_2}」/「{callout_3}」filled #A8D63F
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product} showing three graded size groups in one row, each group a whole unit with one thin slice beside it and identical 3/4 angle, scale and lighting for every group. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a slight 3/4 angle at a consistent height, with one thin matte scale bar lying along the bottom of the row as a size anchor. Identical soft front-left key with fill across all three groups, soft contact shadows, no lighting drift, 5500K. Background matte pale mint board #EEF5E3. The three groups fill 60-70% of the frame overall as one even linear row; each group carries one rounded spec tag filled #A8D63F reading 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 beneath it, completing the balanced grading layout. Negative: no invented sizes, weights or grades, no mixed lighting or scale between groups, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra props.

shots.intent: 降风险，讲清品控流程与发货新鲜承诺
shots.camera: 平视正面轻微转三/四侧，产品位于左侧，标签栈位于右侧
shots.lighting: 均匀干净高调影棚光，柔和补光，轻微接触阴影，5500K
shots.background: 无缝纯白 #FFFFFF + 一张浅豆绿卡 #EEF5E3
shots.props: 三个实心圆角标签 + 一枚实心圆形徽章 #2E5B2C（含白色细线图标）
shots.textZone: 三条短信任标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_3}」in #2E5B2C；圆徽居中于标签栈顶部
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown clean in a straight-on eye-level view turned to a gentle 3/4, placed left of a pale mint card #EEF5E3 holding a vertical stack of three rounded labels, with one solid circular badge filled #2E5B2C carrying a simple white thin-line glyph centered at the top of the stack. Even clean high-key studio light with soft fill and a gentle contact shadow, 5500K. Background seamless pure white #FFFFFF. Three short trust labels read 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 in #2E5B2C; the product and the label card together fill 50-60% of the frame as one balanced left-right trust layout. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, test data or farm qualifications; no fabricated seals, no fake test reports, no false origin claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用行动号召按钮收束整瓜加切片组合的下单决策
shots.camera: 略微低角度 15° 仰视组合机位，两只整瓜加扇形切片
shots.lighting: 明亮柔光加轻微轮廓光，接触阴影利落，5500K
shots.background: 鲜黄绿海报底 #A8D63F，边缘深叶绿渐晕 #2E5B2C
shots.props: 一只圆形浅色木托盘；无其他道具
shots.textZone: 下部一条深叶绿 #2E5B2C 实心按钮，内含白色 CTA 文案「{callout_1}」；按钮上方一行短标题「{callout_2}」in #2E5B2C
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}, a group view on a round light-wood tray #C79A63 with two whole units and a fanned set of thin slices, photographed from a slightly low 15-degree angle looking upward. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright soft studio light with a gentle rim and crisp contact shadows, 5500K. Background vivid yellow-green poster field #A8D63F with a soft deep leaf-green vignette #2E5B2C. The tray group fills 55-60% of the frame in the upper two thirds; the lower quarter completes the poster with one short headline 「{callout_2}」 in #2E5B2C above one solid rounded button filled #2E5B2C carrying white CTA text 「{callout_1}」, all composing one balanced closing layout. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdowns, no fabricated claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 从 10 张 800×1200 竖版爆款详情页切片提炼；已剥离店铺会员码卡片、疑似品牌名、英文标语与全部原文案，产地/基地/资质/农残/营养数值一律不带入，由使用方按实际信息补充；产品一律以 {product} 占位，源图仅保留海报标题带、圆徽图标行、四字卖点卡与规格分级等可复用排版语法。
